title: Driver made it worth it
text: Our driver was AMAZING! He was very friendly, knowledgeable and even had treats for the kids. He was very accommodating as well. He was able to share best photo spots, constantly asked for feedback if we wanted to change anything. Very stress free way to travel around the best spots in the city with 4 young kids.
author: Adriana_S

title: Great tour by Ahmed Fazal
text: Had an amazingly informative and fun 2.5 hour tour of Barcelona by Ahmed Fazal ( Welcome Pickups). He was very knowledgeable, gave us time for photos, took photos of us, made the time very enjoyable. Thank you Ahmed

title: Perfect for a business trip side tour
text: In the words of my boss, this was a brilliant tour!  My colleagues and I were on a business trip to Barcelona and wanted to see the city's highlights in a few hours.  Ivan was an excellent driver and a wonderful guide - all stops were timed and scheduled, and the tour ran very efficiently. We did in a few hours what otherwise might have taken us a whole day! And the personalized touch and flexibility were what our executive team needed. Everyone loved it!  Thank you Ivan!!
